evidence_semantics.native_exists: The exact ID was returned by the supported current list surface.
evidence_semantics.catalog_declared: The local revision-1 entitlement catalog declares the relationship.
evidence_semantics.course_to_cohort: The supported course list nests the cohort under the course.
evidence_semantics.attachment_unverified: These list surfaces do not prove access-group-to-course attachment.

unsupported_relationships: Access-group to course attachment is not exposed by the supported list surfaces.
Group or course existence does not prove purchase, entitlement, membership, progress, class assignment, or publication state.
Matching or similar labels do not prove object identity; exact native IDs remain required.
Course-to-cohort nesting does not establish a checkout offer, roster, delivery-block, or capacity relationship.
